about_the_game:
Final Stand is a top-down shooting game that combines light Roguelite with construction elements. You can play as a soldier by yourself or with your friends, and use a variety of weapons and props to repel endless enemies!

Main Features

10+ gun arsenal: from shotguns to flamethrowers, pigeon + shooting, from scraping to invincibility, directly addictive!

42 talent combinations: match different talents and weapons according to your preferences to unlock different surprise experiences!

86 battlefield relics: defeat various ferocious monsters, choose the relics that suit you, and experience the instantly powerful feeling!

Support LAN connection: pick up guns, call friends, and blow up monsters together!

Play at any time: 10-20 minutes a game, come to an exciting lunch break adventure at any time!

content_descriptors.notes:
"This game contains the following adult content:
- Mild violence: Players use weapons to fight zombies, including cartoonish blood effects"

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit / Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750Ti(2GB) / AMD Radeon R7 370(2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible soundcard / Onboard chipset
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit / Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060(3GB) / AMD Radeon RX570(4GB)

short_description: This is a top-down shooting game. You will fight alone or form a team to break through the apocalypse of monsters. By combining random weapons, talents and relics, you can create a unique fighting style and experience the thrill of counterattack from struggling to survive to mowing down enemies!
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal
